scheme_name: Financial Assistance to dependents in Case of Death of Registered Workers(JKBOCWWB)
other_conditions: The applicant must be a dependent of the deceased worker.
The deceased worker must have been registered with the Jammu and Kashmir Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The deceased worker must have held an active membership with the Board.
The scheme can be applied only once.
benefits_summary: A financial assistance of ₹2,00,000 is provided to the dependents of a deceased registered worker.
documents_required: Bank Passbook Copy (must show 16‑digit account number and applicant’s photo)
